user_saw: On a phone, dashboard reports and session progress cards showed only part of their content in a small inner scroller that captured swipes instead of scrolling the dashboard.
summary: In the phone layout, board grid rows grow with content so reports and session progress cards fit their content (never below saved size), while other widgets keep their saved height.
reasoning: The narrow-board rule that stacks cards at their saved row span is older than the graft and is commented as deliberate ('Keep desktop sizes canonical; only placement changes on narrow boards'), and scrolling inside a user-sized card is the intended desktop behavior that the fix keeps. The fix is a phone-layout design change rather than a repair of broken code; a case could be made for latent, exposed when native DOM reports (e90a3baabc14, #139306) grew much taller when stacked at phone width.
